==Notes==
*The health regeneration is given only to those allies in earshot who are below 75% health at the moment this skill is used. It will continue on all affected allies until the shout expires, even when their health goes above 75%.
*[[Hero]]es use this skill when a party member is below 75% health.
{{Bug|Heroes consider party members outside of the actual range (roughly twice of earshot).}}

{{Anomaly|This skill will affect summoned creatures, like [[spirits]] or [[minions]], if used by a summoned ally, such as the [[Imperial Guard Ally|Imperial Guard Captain]].}}

==Trivia==
*"Never Surrender!" and [["Never Give Up!"]] might be references to the catchline of the movie [[W:Galaxy Quest|Galaxy Quest]]: "Never give up. Never surrender!"
*The figure in this [[skill icon]] is a female [[Necromancer Istani armor|necromancer in Istani armor]]
